title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash CPU wall-time — baseline vs optimized vs roofline (EMR, GNR)
subtitle: 43L two-depth extrapolation (4L+8L dummy proxy, real-router guard so routing matches the real ~59 distinct experts/B=32). Baseline = fully naive (eager DSA + OMP spin + no thread-cap). Optimized = all-C/AMX kernels (dispatch-proven) + spin OMP, all cores. B=32, S=128. Roofline from MEASURED EMR constants (pcl-spr08: AMX bf16 12.4 TFLOPS, DRAM 848 GB/s full-node, uarch-probe job 392787). Accuracy of this path: gsm8k 0.9437 ≈ GPU 0.9535. NB: the prefill roofline is an IDEALIZED upper bound (linear-layer dense-GEMM FLOPs at AMX peak) — only ~40% of real prefill wall-time is that GEMM; ~60% (glue/eager-math/fallback-matmul) is assumed free. See the wall-time page's prefill-headroom analysis.
operating_point: B=32, S=128, G=8 (two-depth extrapolated to 43 layers)

panels.roofline_label: IDEALIZED AMX roofline 409 tok/s — dense-GEMM (linear-layer) FLOPs only; attention/DSA/MHC/glue assumed FREE
